sn22.46:1.5: yadanattā taṃ “netaṃ mama neso ‘hamasmi na meso attā”ti. evametaṃ yathābhūtaṃ sammappaññāya daṭṭhabbaṃ.
sn22.46:1.12: yadanattā taṃ “netaṃ mama, neso ‘hamasmi, na meso attā”ti evametaṃ yathābhūtaṃ sammappaññāya daṭṭhabbaṃ,
sn22.46:2.1: evametaṃ yathābhūtaṃ sammappaññāya passato pubbantānudiṭṭhiyo na honti.
sn22.46:2.3: aparantānudiṭṭhīnaṃ asati, thāmasā parāmāso na hoti.
sn22.46:2.8: viññāṇasmiṃ cittaṃ virajjati, vimuccati anupādāya āsavehi.
sn22.46:2.9: vimuttattā ṭhitaṃ. ṭhitattā santusitaṃ. santusitattā na paritassati. aparitassaṃ paccattaṃyeva parinibbāyati.
sn22.46:2.10: “khīṇā jāti, vusitaṃ brahmacariyaṃ, kataṃ karaṇīyaṃ, nāparaṃ itthattāyā”ti pajānātīti.
